note: Each `example` is the whole body of a delivery, with made-up values. `data` holds the fields listed for the event.

events.description: A contact wrote to one of your numbers. Nothing a contact sends is dropped: a message WhatsApp cannot pass on arrives as `type` `unsupported`, a change of number as `system`, a reaction as `type` `reaction` (with `reaction_to`, the message it is on, and `emoji`, empty when removed), and a message from a blocked contact with `blocked: true`.

fields.name: message_id
fields.description: The message.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.description: Its conversation.

fields.name: contact_id
fields.description: The contact.

fields.name: channel_id
fields.description: The channel (the number).

fields.name: channel_type
fields.description: The kind of channel, for example `whatsapp`.

fields.name: provider_message_id
fields.description: The provider's id for the message.

fields.name: from
fields.description: The sender's phone number.

fields.name: profile_name
fields.description: The name the sender gave their profile.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The kind of message: `text`, `image`, `audio`, `document`, `location`, `interactive`, `system` (the contact changed number), `reaction` (an emoji on an earlier message: `reaction_to` and `emoji` say which and what), `unsupported` (a kind WhatsApp does not pass on)…

fields.name: text
fields.description: The text, when there is one.

fields.name: reply
fields.description: The button or list choice the contact made, when it is a reply.

fields.name: location
fields.description: The location the contact shared, when it is one.

fields.name: referral
fields.description: Where the contact came from (a click-to-WhatsApp ad or post), as Meta gave it, when it is one.

fields.name: media
fields.description: The file: `url` (Nodium's copy, behind your key), `mime_type`, `filename`.

fields.name: window_expires_at
fields.description: When the 24-hour customer service window of this conversation closes (ISO 8601), counted from the contact's latest message; free-form replies are accepted until then. `null` when the window never opened (a `system` message does not open it).

fields.name: blocked
fields.description: Present and true when the sender is a blocked contact: the message is stored and announced, but nothing should answer it.

fields.name: previous_number
fields.description: On a `system` message where the contact changed number: their old number.

fields.name: new_number
fields.description: On a `system` message where the contact changed number: their new number.

fields.name: reaction_to
fields.description: On a `reaction` only, absent otherwise: the provider's id (`provider_message_id`) of the message the reaction is on. `null` when the provider did not name it.

fields.name: emoji
fields.description: On a `reaction` only, absent otherwise: the emoji, or an empty string when the reaction was removed.

events.description: A past message of a coexistence number, imported from the phone when the number was connected. Not delivered to webhooks: it is written to the event log only (`GET /events`), one entry per message, with `occurred_at` set to when the message was actually written. `history.progress` tells how far the import is.

events.description: A message left for the provider, whoever sent it: your code, the console, a broadcast. It carries the whole content, the `idempotency_key` it was sent with, so you can tell your own sends from the others, and `to`, who it went to: a send you did not make can be to a contact you have never heard from.

fields.description: The refusal explained, when the provider gave a code: `{ code, title, action, actor }`. `title` says what happened and `action` what to do about it; `actor` says who acts: `you` (your code or console), `client` (the owner of the number: `action` is written to be passed on to them), `nodium`, or `wait` (the refusal is temporary). `null` when the failure carries no provider code.

example.title: Missing or declined payment method on your client's WhatsApp account: Meta blocks paid messages.
example.action: Add a valid payment method to your WhatsApp Business account in WhatsApp Manager, under payment methods. Messages will then go out normally.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why, as a stable code. Refused by Nodium when it was about to leave, nothing sent to the provider: `channel_inactive` (the number is switched off, by its owner, by Meta or by the plan), `contact_blocked`, `window_closed` (free text outside the 24-hour window, for a queued, scheduled or retried message). `payment_missing` when the client has no payment method at Meta.

error_info.title: Missing or declined payment method on your client's WhatsApp account: Meta blocks paid messages.
error_info.action: Add a valid payment method to your WhatsApp Business account in WhatsApp Manager, under payment methods. Messages will then go out normally.

events.description: A number could not be connected: your client opened Meta's window (hosted connect link or console) and it was closed before the end, Meta showed an error, or a step failed on Nodium's side. `code` is stable; `reason` is a sentence for a person. Nothing was connected: the client can try again, or you can reach out.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Why it failed. In the browser: `window_closed` (see `step`), `meta_error` (Meta showed an error), `popup_blocked`. On Nodium's side: `code_refused`, `waba_not_granted`, `no_number`, `number_mismatch`, `numbers_unreadable`, `other_workspace`, `other_provider`, `subscribe_failed`, `system_user_blind`, `pin_mismatch`, `register_failed`, `signup_unavailable` or `unknown`.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: The failure, as a sentence.
fields.example: Meta refused to register the number.

fields.name: step
fields.description: For `window_closed` and `meta_error`: the screen of Meta's window where it stopped, as Meta names it.

fields.name: phone_number_id
fields.description: Meta's id of the number, when Meta had already told us which one.

fields.name: display_number
fields.description: The number as it is dialled, when known.

fields.name: connect_link_id
fields.description: The connect link that was used, when there was one.

data.reason: Meta refused to register the number.

events.description: A number's quality rating or messaging tier changed, its payment method went missing or came back, or Meta changed the state of its WhatsApp account (application removed, account disabled or restored, review, display name).

fields.name: channel_id
fields.description: The channel (the number).

fields.name: event
fields.description: What happened: a Meta quality event, `payment_missing`, `payment_restored`, or a state of the account such as `PARTNER_REMOVED`, `DISABLED_UPDATE`, `account_review_approved`, `name_rejected`.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: On account events: whether the channel is still switched on after the change. Meta cutting the number switches it off.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: On account events: the reason Meta gives, when it gives one.

fields.name: quality_rating
fields.description: The quality rating now: `GREEN`, `YELLOW`, `RED`.

fields.name: previous_quality_rating
fields.description: The rating before.

fields.name: messaging_limit
fields.description: The messaging tier now.

fields.name: previous_messaging_limit
fields.description: The tier before.

fields.name: payment_missing
fields.description: On payment events: whether the payment method is missing.

events.description: A chunk of the history of a coexistence number was imported (the conversations the phone already had). One event per chunk: the messages themselves go to the event log as `message.imported`, without ringing.

fields.name: channel_id
fields.description: The channel (the number).

fields.name: progress
fields.description: How far the import is, from 0 to 100.

fields.name: imported
fields.description: How many messages have been imported so far.

fields.name: status
fields.description: `running`, `done`, or `declined` when the owner of the phone refused to share the history.
